112:2.text: [Allâh the Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, (He neither eats nor drinks)]

112:3.text: "He begets not, nor was He begotten.

112:4.text: "And there is none co-equal or comparable unto Him."

113:2.text: "From the evil of what He has created,

113:3.text: "And from the evil of the darkening
as it comes with its darkness;
(or the moon as it sets or goes away)

113:4.text: "And from the evil of those who practise witchcraft when they blow in the knots,

113:5.text: "And from the evil of the envier when he envies."

114:4.text: (devil who whispers evil in the hearts of men)
(from his whispering in one’s heart after one remembers Allâh)

114:5.text: "Who whispers in the breasts of mankind.
